body.p: The present application included claims 1-26. Claims 1, 7, 22, and 26 have been amended. Claim 2 was canceled without prejudice or disclaimer. New claim 27 has been added.1

Claims 1-21 and 26 were rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-3 and 5-11 of U.S. Patent No. 11,999,494, and claims 1-10 of U.S. Patent No. 12,172,761 (the "reference patents"). The Applicant is concurrently filing terminal disclaimers with respect to the reference patents to render these rejections moot.

Claims 1 and 22-26 were rejected as being anticipated by U.S. 2017/0050737 ("Hartman"). Claims 1 and 3-11 were rejected as being anticipated by U.S. 3,679,025 ("Rummel"). Claims 1 and 12-21 were rejected as being anticipated by U.S. 3,866,734 ("Elkins").

In order to expedite prosecution toward allowance, claim 1 has been amended to recite the limitations of previously pending claim 2, which was objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form. See April 2, 2025 Office Action at page 2. Claims 22 and 26 have been similarly amended. Accordingly, claims 1, 22, 26, and any claims depending therefrom are in condition for allowance.

The claim amendments are not to be interpreted as an acknowledgement of the propriety of the claim rejections. Instead, as noted above, the claims have been amended to expedite prosecution toward allowance. The Applicant reserves the right to pursue the subject matter of the claims, as previously recited, in a continuation application.

In general, the Office Action makes various statements regarding the pending claims and the cited references that are now moot in light of the above. Thus, the Applicant will not address such statements at the present time. However, the Applicant expressly reserves the right to challenge such statements in the future should the need arise (e.g., if such statements should become relevant by appearing in a rejection of any current or future claim).
1 No fee is due with respect to new claim 27, as it replaces canceled claim 2.

The Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the claim rejections for at least the reasons discussed above. If the Examiner has any questions or the Applicant can be of any assistance, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney.
Respectfully Submitted, Date: April 9, 2025 /Joseph M. Butscher/
